name: named-closing-tag
description: the closing tag repeats the opening name; nested elements restore the outer binding

name: heredoc
description: the closing line repeats the opening tag; indented lines may contain the tag

name: sequential-values
description: two value parameters in order, a by-name one, and a value passed by name

name: forwarded-and-nested-values
description: Again(v) matches the value once more; Pair(Pair('b')) shadows and restores Pair(=p)

name: empty-and-unused-values
description: an empty value and a value parameter that the body never uses

name: alternatives-and-choice-body
description: retrying a shared instance after a failed alternative; a choice body

name: user-captures-beside-values
description: user capture tag and value parameter tag are separate bindings

name: value-nesting-at-limit
description: the CAPTURE_SCOPE of a value instance counts toward the inline nesting of 128

name: value-arity
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a', 'b'); F(=x) ::= x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-ARITY: rule F expects 1 argument(s), got 2; defined at line 1, column 37

name: value-duplicate-parameter
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a', 'b'); F(=x, x) ::= x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-DUPLICATE: parameter x is declared more than once in rule F

name: value-parameter-shadows-rule
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a'); F(=Root) ::= Root; }

error.message: E-PARAM-SHADOW: parameter Root of rule F has the same name as a rule or token

name: value-cycle
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a'); F(=x) ::= 'a' F(x) | x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-CYCLE: parameterized call cycle F -> F; expansion would not terminate

name: value-capture-in-argument
grammar: grammar Bad { @root @mapping(Node, params=[t]) Root ::= F('a' @t); F(=x) ::= x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-CAPTURE: captures and @typeof are not allowed in parameterized rule bodies or call arguments

name: value-annotation
grammar: grammar Bad { @root F(=x) ::= x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-ANNOTATION: parameterized rule F cannot have annotations; only transparent rules take parameters

name: value-undefined
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a'); F(=x) ::= y; }

error.message: E-PARAM-UNDEFINED: rule F references undefined parameter, rule or token 'y'

name: value-reserved-name
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= 'a'; SAME_AS(=x) ::= x; }

error.message: E-PARAM-RESERVED: parameterized rule name SAME_AS is reserved by a builtin call

name: value-name-collision
grammar: grammar Bad { Root ::= F('a'); F(=x) ::= x; F_810e17933a076cec ::= 'b'; }

error.message: E-PARAM-NAME-COLLISION: expanded rule name F_810e17933a076cec collides with another rule, token or expansion
